facts.text: Eat something, kid. Then we climb the steps together, one at a time, like always.
facts.why: Not found among Rocky's lines on the quote page. His real line is 'One step at a time. One punch at a time. One round at a time.' This one is printed in quote marks.
facts.fix: One step at a time. One punch at a time. One round at a time.

facts.text: Serve the mains when Adonis and Bianca go out for cheesesteaks.
facts.why: Adonis asks Bianca to eat, they go to Max's in North Philly, and he orders a steak sandwich with peppers and extra cheese. He says he asked her out, though she says it is not a date.

The tag says 'Adonis Creed, member' in Philadelphia. Delphi is a Los Angeles gym (Delphi Boxing Academy) that turns him away. In Philadelphia he trains at the Front Street Gym. The same name sits in the winks list.
facts.full: Delphi Boxing Club / Adonis Creed, member / Philadelphia
facts.applied_note: Prop title changed to Front Street Gym. The Delphi wink stays: Delphi is a real gym in the film (Los Angeles).

vibe.verdict: A good Philly bistro with Adrian's, the flag trunks and the steps, but it puts Delphi in Philadelphia and uses little of the training story.
